span.label: A DIAGNOSTIC THRESHOLD THAT DEFINED A DISEASE FOR 45 YEARS, LOWERED - pulmonary hypertension moves from mPAP >=25 mmHg, set at the 1st World Symposium in 1973 and called arbitrary in that meeting's own report, to >20 mmHg, the 97.5th percentile of 1187 normal subjects
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: whether pulmonary hypertension and pre-capillary pulmonary hypertension should be redefined, whether exercise PH should be brought back into the definition, and what the clinical classification should contain
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a haemodynamic definition of pre-capillary PH with three simultaneous conditions - mPAP >20 mmHg, PAWP <=15 mmHg, PVR >=3 WU - a refusal to reintroduce exercise PH, and a simplified clinical classification with two new group 1 subgroups and two demotions out of group 5
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a disease whose presence is decided entirely by numbers from a catheter, where the numbers have no natural boundary and the boundary chosen changes who is ill
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a World Symposium task force reviewing published haemodynamic data - a pooled analysis of normal subjects, cohort studies of patients between the old and new thresholds, and the exercise-haemodynamics literature - and voting a classification
span.term: a World Symposium task force reviewing published haemodynamic data - a pooled analysis of normal subjects, cohort studies of patients between the old and new thresholds, and the exercise-haemodynamics literature - and voting a classification
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **THE OLD NUMBER WAS ARBITRARY AND THE 1973 MEETING SAID SO**: `it was recognised that this upper limit of normal mPAP of 25 mmHg WAS SOMEWHAT EMPIRICAL AND ARBITRARILY DEFINED. However, THIS CONSERVATIVE CUT-OFF VALUE ALLOWED PHYSICIANS TO DISCRIMINATE SEVERE PH due to primary PH FROM OTHER FORMS OF PH ... characterised by a lower mPAP.` **The threshold was chosen to separate the severe cases from everything else**, not to mark where normal ends - a working boundary that became the definition of a disease for 45 years
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND IT WAS KEPT FOR ITS CONSEQUENCES, NOT ITS ACCURACY**: `This definition REMAINED UNCHANGED during the subsequent WSPH meetings FROM 1998 TO 2013, AT LEAST IN PART TO PRECLUDE POTENTIAL OVERDIAGNOSIS AND OVERTREATMENT OF PH.` Four international meetings declined to move a number they knew was arbitrary, because of what moving it would do. **A definition held in place by its downstream effects is the cleanest instance of this in the corpus**
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND THE NEW NUMBER WAS ALREADY IN THE 1961 REPORT**: `In 1961, a report of the World Health Organization (WHO) Expert Committee on Chronic Cor Pulmonale mentioned clearly that the mean pulmonary arterial pressure DOES NOT NORMALLY EXCEED 15 mmHg ... and that the value was little affected by age AND NEVER EXCEEDED 20 mmHg.` The 2018 threshold is 20 mmHg. **The evidence for the new boundary is 57 years older than the boundary it replaces**, and the paper cites it as its first reference
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND THE NEW ONE IS A PERCENTILE**: from `1187 NORMAL SUBJECTS FROM 47 STUDIES`, `mPAP at rest was 14.0+/-3.3 mmHg`, so `TWO STANDARD DEVIATIONS would suggest mPAP >20 mmHg as above the upper limit of normal ( i.e. ABOVE THE 97.5TH PERCENTILE). THIS DEFINITION IS, THEREFORE, NO LONGER ARBITRARY, BUT BASED ON A SCIENTIFIC APPROACH.` **The replacement for an arbitrary cut is a distributional convention** - mean plus two standard deviations is a choice about how much of a normal population to call abnormal, and 2.5% is as much a convention as 25 mmHg was
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND THE COMPANION CRITERION IS ADMITTED TO BE ARBITRARY, FOUR PARAGRAPHS LATER**: `This cut-off value of PVR >=3 WU IS ALSO QUITE ARBITRARY since some recent data suggest that PVR >2 WU could be also considered abnormal. In this sense, the use of a cut-off value of PVR >=3 WU IS CONSERVATIVE.` **One definition, two thresholds: one de-arbitrarised by a percentile and one defended as arbitrary and conservative**, and the same document says both
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND A NUMBER ALONE IS DECLARED INSUFFICIENT TO NAME A DISEASE: `Whatever the mPAP cut-off value considered for defining PH (>=25 or >20 mmHg), it is important to emphasise that THIS VALUE USED IN ISOLATION CANNOT CHARACTERISE A CLINICAL CONDITION AND DOES NOT DEFINE THE PATHOLOGICAL PROCESS PER SE.` The pressure can be raised by cardiac output, by a shunt, by wedge pressure or by blood viscosity - so the definition needs a second measurement to say WHERE the resistance is
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND THE PATIENTS ADDED BY THE CHANGE HAVE NO EVIDENCE BASE**: `a change in the haemodynamic definition of PH due to PVDs DOES NOT IMPLY TREATING THESE ADDITIONAL PATIENTS, but highlights the importance of close monitoring in this population. PROSPECTIVE TRIALS ARE REQUIRED TO DETERMINE WHETHER THIS PH POPULATION MIGHT BENEFIT FROM SPECIFIC MANAGEMENT.` **A diagnosis is extended to people for whom no treatment is indicated and none has been tested** - stated plainly, in the section that makes the change
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE EVIDENCE FOR MOVING IT IS THAT THE EXCLUDED BAND ALREADY BEHAVES LIKE THE DISEASE: of 38 systemic sclerosis patients with mPAP 21-24 mmHg re-catheterised, `16 OF THESE (42%) DEVELOPED OVERT PH`, and `Patients with so-called BORDERLINE mPAP at diagnosis WERE MORE LIKELY TO DEVELOP OVERT PAH THAN patients with mPAP <=20 mmHg (HR 3.7)`. In a 547-patient Austrian cohort, `BOTH BORDERLINE PH AND MANIFEST PH WERE SIGNIFICANTLY ASSOCIATED WITH POOR SURVIVAL` (HR 2.37 and 5.05). **The band between the old threshold and the new one was never healthy; it was outside the definition**
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND A DEFINITION REMOVED IN 2008 WAS NOT RESTORED, FOR A MEASUREMENT REASON: `In 2004, PH was defined as resting mPAP >25 mmHg OR EXERCISE mPAP >30 mmHg. At the 4th WSPH in 2008, however, THE `EXERCISE` PART OF THE DEFINITION WAS REMOVED.` Revisited in 2018 and refused again - `TOO MANY UNCERTAINTIES PERSIST TO ALLOW THE REINTRODUCTION of a clinically useful definition of exercise PH` - because `IT WAS IMPOSSIBLE TO DISTINGUISH LHD FROM PVD PATIENTS WITH CONFIDENCE` and the measurement is `IMPRACTICAL AS A CLINICAL ROUTINE`. **A criterion refused on the grounds that it cannot be measured, not that it is untrue**
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND ONE WHOLE CLASS IS DEFINED BY WHAT IS NOT KNOWN ABOUT ITS MEMBERS**: `the concept supporting the classification of a clinical condition ... INTO GROUP 5 is, again, THE LACK OF ROBUST DATA ALLOWING A DEFINITE RECOGNITION OF PREDOMINANT PATHOPHYSIOLOGICAL MECHANISMS, or describing the histopathological findings or yet, describing management strategies.` Group 5 was `disorders directly affecting the pulmonary vasculature` in 1998 and `MISCELLANEOUS` in 2003. **Membership is an epistemic state, not a property of the disease** - a paper leaves group 5 when the literature improves, not when the patient changes
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND TWO MEMBERS WERE DEMOTED FROM CONDITIONS TO RISK FACTORS: splenectomy, because `NO OTHER PARTICULAR PHENOTYPE OR CHANGE IN CLINICAL BEHAVIOUR HAS BEEN ASSOCIATED with [it], suggesting that IT SHOULD BE BETTER CONSIDERED AS A RISK FACTOR FOR PH INSTEAD OF A PARTICULAR CONDITION deserving a specific classification`; and thyroid disorders, `IT WAS A CONSENSUS TO WITHDRAW [them] FROM THE CLASSIFICATION AS A SPECIFIC ENTITY and better discuss their role as risk factors`. **The test for being a class rather than a correlate is whether membership predicts anything else**
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE BAR FOR MOVING ANYTHING ELSE IS STATED: `We propose that CHANGES BE MADE ONLY AFTER THE GENERATION OF ROBUST DATA TO SUPPORT SUCH RECLASSIFICATION.` A classification that names its own amendment rule - compare the same task force moving two entries out on exactly that ground in the paragraphs above
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **THE STRONGEST SENTENCE AGAINST THE PAPER IS THE PAPER'S OWN**: `This cut-off value of PVR >=3 WU IS ALSO QUITE ARBITRARY.` The abstract sells the mPAP change as `no longer arbitrary, but based on a scientific approach`; the definition it proposes requires BOTH numbers, and only one of them has been de-arbitrarised. **A definition is no more principled than its least principled conjunct**
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND `NO LONGER ARBITRARY` MEANS `A DIFFERENT CONVENTION`: mean plus two standard deviations in `1187 NORMAL SUBJECTS FROM 47 STUDIES` is a rule about how much of a healthy population to place outside normal - `ABOVE THE 97.5TH PERCENTILE`. It is reproducible, auditable and far better than a show of hands, and **it is still a choice of tail**. The paper does not claim 20 mmHg is where the pathology starts; it claims it is where the normal distribution ends
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE NEW DIAGNOSIS COMES WITH NOTHING TO DO ABOUT IT: `PROSPECTIVE TRIALS ARE REQUIRED TO DETERMINE WHETHER THIS PH POPULATION MIGHT BENEFIT FROM SPECIFIC MANAGEMENT.` The task force is explicit that widening the definition `DOES NOT IMPLY TREATING THESE ADDITIONAL PATIENTS` - which is the right disclosure, and leaves every patient newly inside the boundary with a disease name and a monitoring plan
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE OVERDIAGNOSIS ARGUMENT IS ANSWERED BY REDIRECTING IT: `For many years, the diagnosis of PH was based on an arbitrary value ... probably because of UNDERSTANDABLE CONCERN ABOUT OVERDIAGNOSIS AND OVERTREATMENT. Actually, THE MAIN CAUSE OF OVERDIAGNOSIS ... IS THE FAILURE TO CONFIRM THE DIAGNOSIS BY RHC.` The reply is that overdiagnosis comes from skipping the catheter rather than from where the line sits - **true, and it does not measure how many more people the new line admits**, which this paper does not estimate
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE DISCLOSURES ARE DENSE AND UNIFORM: `Quotation withheld` Seven of the eight authors file a comparable statement, most naming Actelion. Every one is declared, none is hidden, and **a task force that widens a disease boundary is advised by people paid by the manufacturers of its treatments** - which is a fact about the field's structure, not an allegation about this paper
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: requiring PAWP <=15 mmHg and PVR >=3 WU alongside the pressure, so that a raised mPAP counts only when it is resistance

span.label: `pulmonary hypertension`, 1973-2018 sense - `mPAP >=25 mmHg at rest, measured by right heart catheterisation`, a value the defining meeting called `SOMEWHAT EMPIRICAL AND ARBITRARILY DEFINED`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `pre-capillary PH`, 2018 sense - THREE conditions at once: `mPAP >20 mmHg, PAWP <=15 mmHg and PVR >=3 WU`. The second and third exist to say that the raised pressure is resistance and not flow or wedge
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `borderline PH` - mPAP 21-24 mmHg: the band between the old threshold and the new one, which had a name while it was outside the definition
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `exercise PH` - part of the definition in 2004 (`exercise mPAP >30 mmHg`), removed in 2008, reconsidered and refused in 2018 because exercise PAWP cannot be measured reliably enough to tell left heart disease from pulmonary vascular disease
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `group 5` - PH `with unclear and/or multifactorial mechanisms`; previously `disorders directly affecting the pulmonary vasculature` (1998) and `MISCELLANEOUS` (2003). **The class of conditions we do not yet understand**
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: pulmonary hypertension (PH) —operationalised-as→ mean pulmonary arterial pressure (mPAP) ≥25 mmHg at rest
span.term: mean pulmonary arterial pressure (mPAP) ≥25 mmHg at rest
span.note: the relation itself is separately evidenced · strength of the relation: 0.95 — `Since the 1st World Symposium on Pulmonary Hypertension (WSPH) in 1973, pulmonary hypertension (PH) HAS BEEN ARBITRARILY DEFINED AS mean pulmonary arterial pressure (mPAP) >=25 mmHg AT REST, MEASURED BY RIGHT HEART CATHETERISATION.` **The adverb is the authors' own**, in the first sentence of the abstract - and the 1973 report is quoted later saying the same thing about itself
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Pre-capillary PH —operationalised-as→ mPAP >20 mmHg, PAWP ≤15 mmHg and PVR ≥3 WU
span.term: mPAP >20 mmHg, PAWP ≤15 mmHg and PVR ≥3 WU
span.note: the relation itself is separately evidenced · strength of the relation: 0.95 — `PRE-CAPILLARY PH IS BEST DEFINED BY THE CONCOMITANT PRESENCE OF mPAP >20 mmHg, PAWP <=15 mmHg AND PVR >=3 WU, emphasising the need for RHC with mandatory measurement of CO and accurate measurement of PAWP.` **Lowering one threshold forced two more into the definition** - because `THIS VALUE USED IN ISOLATION CANNOT CHARACTERISE A CLINICAL CONDITION`, and the further down the pressure scale you go the more true that is
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: increase in cardiac output —causes→ PAP elevation
span.note: the relation itself is separately evidenced · strength of the relation: 0.9 — `PAP ELEVATION MAY INDEED HAVE SEVERAL DIFFERENT CAUSES with different management and outcomes, INCLUDING INCREASE IN CARDIAC OUTPUT (CO), LEFT-TO-RIGHT CARDIAC SHUNTS, ELEVATION OF PULMONARY ARTERIAL WEDGE PRESSURE (PAWP) in left heart disease AND HYPERVISCOSITY.` The edge runs from the cause to the reading, against the order of the sentence. **This is the argument that forced PVR into the definition**: a measurement with many causes cannot, alone, be a diagnosis
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: LHD —contrasted-with→ PVD
span.note: the relation itself is separately evidenced · strength of the relation: 0.95 — `Quotation withheld.` Typed `contrasted-with` deliberately: **the finding is that the two are NOT separable by this measurement**, which is the opposite of asserting a distinction. A whole criterion was dropped on it
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: PAH —contrasted-with→ PVOD/PCH
span.note: the relation itself is separately evidenced · strength of the relation: 0.95 — `Quotation withheld` **A distinction removed by reclassification, not by new pathology** - the same year, the same task force added a subgroup for calcium-channel-blocker responders on the grounds that they ARE a distinct entity. Both moves are argued from `clinical consequences`
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: forms of PH with unclear and/or multifactorial mechanisms —part-of→ group 5
span.term: forms of PH with unclear and/or multifactorial mechanisms
span.note: the relation itself is separately evidenced · strength of the relation: 0.9 — `Since the basis of our classification system was established in 1998, GROUP 5 HAS PASSED THROUGH SIGNIFICANT CHANGES. Initially describing `disorders directly affecting the pulmonary vasculature`, THEN NAMED `MISCELLANEOUS` during the 3rd WSPH in 2003, and finally reaching its current presentation, THIS GROUP INCLUDES FORMS OF PH WITH UNCLEAR AND/OR MULTIFACTORIAL MECHANISMS.` **The renaming across three meetings has no edge type in schema 0.3** - `renamed-across-fields` is false here, because it is one field renaming its own category over time. Filed in the open questions rather than forced into the nearest type
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: PAH with vasoreactivity —distinct-from→ IPAH
span.note: the relation itself is separately evidenced · strength of the relation: 0.95 — `Quotation withheld.` The subgroup is created because `These results suggest A SPECIFIC ENTITY WITH A DISTINCT CLINICAL COURSE, characterised by significantly better prognosis, UNIQUE MANAGEMENT and different pathophysiology`. **A class created by treatment response and then corroborated molecularly** - the reverse of the usual order, and the paper is candid that `Pathophysiology of PAH with vasoreactivity is largely unknown`
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: borderline mPAP —contrasted-with→ mPAP ≤20 mmHg
span.note: the relation itself is separately evidenced · strength of the relation: 0.95 — `PATIENTS WITH SO-CALLED BORDERLINE mPAP AT DIAGNOSIS WERE MORE LIKELY TO DEVELOP OVERT PAH THAN PATIENTS WITH mPAP <=20 mmHg (p<0.001; hazard ratio (HR) 3.7).` **The comparison is between two bands of one continuous variable**, and it is the only kind of evidence that can move a threshold: show that the excluded side already behaves like the included one
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: drugs with data based on outbreaks, epidemiological case–control studies or large multicentre series —part-of→ Definite association
span.term: drugs with data based on outbreaks, epidemiological case–control studies or large multicentre series
span.note: the relation itself is separately evidenced · strength of the relation: 0.9 — `'DEFINITE ASSOCIATION' INCLUDES DRUGS WITH DATA BASED ON OUTBREAKS, EPIDEMIOLOGICAL CASE-CONTROL STUDIES OR LARGE MULTICENTRE SERIES. 'POSSIBLE ASSOCIATION' is suggested by multiple case series or cases with drugs with SIMILAR MECHANISMS OF ACTION.` **An evidential grade written into a classification** - and note the asymmetry: mechanism similarity is enough for `possible` and never enough for `definite`
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
